mapper.select: SELECT INTERVIEW_NO , ROOM_TITLE , MAX_JOIN_COUNT , START_DATE , END_DATE , COMPANY_INTERVIEW_URL , VIDEO_INTERVIEW_DEL_DATE , ROOM_ID FROM VIDEO_INTERVIEW
SELECT INTERVIEW_NO , ROOM_TITLE , MAX_JOIN_COUNT , START_DATE , END_DATE , COMPANY_INTERVIEW_URL , VIDEO_INTERVIEW_DEL_DATE , ROOM_ID FROM VIDEO_INTERVIEW WHERE INTERVIEW_NO = #{interviewNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE VIDEO_INTERVIEW SET ROOM_TITLE = #{roomTitle}, MAX_JOIN_COUNT = #{maxJoinCount}, START_DATE = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{startDate}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), END_DATE = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{endDate}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), COMPANY_INTERVIEW_URL = #{companyInterviewUrl}, VIDEO_INTERVIEW_DEL_DATE = #{videoInterviewDelDate}, ROOM_ID = #{roomId} WHERE INTERVIEW_NO = #{interviewNo}
mapper.select: SELECT VIIN.COMPANY_INTERVIEW_URL FROM VIDEO_INTERVIEW VIIN, INTERVIEW INTE, RECRUIT_PROCESS PEPR, RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RENO WHERE VIIN.INTERVIEW_NO = INTE.INTERVIEW_NO AND INTE.PROCESS_NO = PEPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AND PEPR.RECRUITMENT_NO = RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO AND VIIN.INTERVIEW_NO = #{interviewNo} AND RENO.USER_ID = #{userId}
